definition: Jim Keller is known for Legendary Microprocessor Architect and CEO of Tenstorrent.
details: Designed iconic chips at AMD (Zen), Apple (A4/A5), and Tesla (Autopilot Hardware 3), and leads Tenstorrent in building open RISC-V AI accelerators. Jim Keller is an American musician, producer, manager, publisher, and composer whose work in the music business spans more than 40 years. He was the co-founder, lead guitarist, and primary songwriter for the American rock band Tommy Tutone based in San Francisco, California, and was co-writer of that band's most famous single, 867-5309/Jenny. Since 1992, Keller has worked with Philip Glass, first running Glass's publishing company and eventually managing his career as director of Dunvagen Music.

explainer.lead: Jim Keller is an American guitarist.

contributions.name: In 1999, Keller founded St. Rose Music as a publishing and management company for friends and associates.
For several years, Keller played in bands, wrote jingles, and helped friends and colleagues with music publishing.

timeline.what: In 1978, Keller and Tommy Heath began playing around the greater San Francisco area with a variety of backup musicians under the billing Tommy Tutone.
By 1979, Heath and Keller were invited to play a label showcase that brought the attention of the Warner Bros. record label.
In early 1981, the band had begun recording their second LP, when Keller approached Heath with a song he had co-written with former Clover frontman Alex Call.
Keller stopped performing and recording in 1994.
He has recorded three solo albums since he left Tommy Tutone, including Sunshine in my Pocket (2009), Soul Candy (2011), and Heaven Can Wait (2014).
His most recent album, produced by Mitchell Froom, was released in February 2021.
